text:
maria: RC v2.14.0-rc3 artifacts are baked and pinned. Release notes drafted (short bullets). Targeting the 13:00-14:00 UTC change window for promote. Need final sign-offs and rollback readiness.

deploy-bot: build ✅ all tests passed. Artifacts pinned: s3://redwood-releases/v2.14.0-rc3, image sha256:abc123def. Dry-run promote to canary succeeded.

kevin: looked at smoke perf — p95 latency down ~3% vs staging baseline. No DB migrations in this RC. KV warm plan ready. LGTM unless anyone sees a blocker.

sam: quick QA smoke run done on staging. Found a benign NPE in telemetry logs (non-blocker), fixed in follow-up patch. Recommend proceed with 5% canary for 15m then ramp.

jia: sheriff check — I'm on duty at 12:50-14:20 UTC. Rollback plan confirmed: 1) pause routing 2) route traffic back to tag v2.13.9 3) disable feature-flag with `ffctl set --name new-gen --state off` 4) rollback DB migrations if any (not applicable here).

maria: perfect. I'll queue the promote at 13:05 UTC. Kevin/sam please be ready to execute rollback runbook if alarm triggers.

kevin: I'm oncall and watching. set an alert for 13:10 to review canary metrics.

sam: canary promote command for reference: `deploybot promote --tag v2.14.0-rc3 --env canary --percent 5 --duration 15m`

maria: thanks. can someone post the final release-note link and the checklist so SRE/CS can prep communications?

jia: release notes diff: https://changelog/redwood/v2.14.0-rc3-diff. Checklist pinned in docs channel.

deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled by maria for 2024-04-02T13:05:00Z. Step 1: canary 5% (us-west-2) for 15m. Canary SLO checks: error-rate threshold 2% / latency delta 20% / saturation.

ops-bot: Reminder: change window closes at 14:00 UTC. If rollback needed use `/run rollback --to-tag v2.13.9` and notify #eng-oncall.

maria: rolling now — initiating canary.

deploy-bot: Canary started — 5% traffic shifted to v2.14.0-rc3. Monitoring: https://telemetry/redwood/canary/6135792000.

(deploy window passes 15m)

deploy-bot: Canary stable after 15m. No SLO violations. Ramping to 50% over 10m.

sam: watching traces and error groups, all green.

kevin: metrics look good. proceed with full ramp per policy.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 100% complete. Production tag v2.14.0 created from rc3. Post-deploy: KV-warm completed, background jobs healthy. Release notes published: https://releases.redwood/v2.14.0.

maria: promoted to prod. thanks everyone — I'll draft the customer-facing announcement and attach release notes. If any regressions appear, follow rollback steps above and ping me. :thumbsup:
